title: Shuai Li
text:
I’m a Ph.D. student in the geography program at the University of Florida, specializing in land cover and land use change-climate interactions.
I’m particularly interested in using geographic information technology to study human-environmental interactions, especially in areas with complex ecology.

Land Cover and Land Use Change
